text:
maya_support: customer report — token-cost dashboard shows $0 / NaN for several orgs after nightly ledger migration. Org IDs: 000555, 7201, 00421. They attached a CSV export where cost column is NaN for some rows. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.s3/.../screenshot.png

samir_backend: can you drop repro steps and the exact date range they used?

maya_support: repro steps I used locally: 1) admin -> Analytics -> Token Cost dashboard 2) select org 000555 (enterprise org) 3) date range last 30d 4) UI shows $0 for totals, hover tooltip shows NaN. CSV export shows "NaN" in cost column for same org. I can reproduce in staging with the same org id.

alex_sre: FYI ingest-bot reported a warning on the ledger backfill job last night. ingest-bot: batch_job_id=ingest-2024-11-02-03 WARN: 12 rows skipped due to parse error in org_id field.

ingest-bot: log snippet: `WARN parse_org_id: failed to cast "000555" -> int at line 1243`

samir_backend: sounds like a type mismatch. Some of our older ledgers stored org_id as string zero-padded, new ledger stores as int. The dashboard aggregate JOIN uses int org_id which fails to match string-padded rows, resulting in NULL aggregated_cost which front-end renders as NaN.

jules_product: how many customers affected? Is this a single-customer support ticket or broader?

maya_support: initial count: 12 orgs across staging and prod. Two enterprise customers filed tickets. Could be more; the CSV export surfaced a few SMB orgs too.

samir_backend: quick diagnostic query I ran in staging: `SELECT org_id_raw, COUNT(*) FROM raw_ledger WHERE org_id_raw ~ '^0+' GROUP BY org_id_raw LIMIT 5;` shows ~9k rows with leading zeros. Aggregate table normalized org_id as integer which dropped those rows. Proposed short-term fix: coalesce(aggregated_cost,0) in the UI to avoid NaN display + backfill script to normalize org_id and re-aggregate.

alex_sre: starting backfill job to normalize org ids and rebuild reporting index. Patch will also add a check to ingestor to strip leading zeros. Running on a small sample first.

deploy-bot: deploying redwood/analytics@fix/zero-padded-orgs to staging (build 2024.11.03.1).

samir_backend: repro snippet for support thread: ```sql
-- find mismatched ids
SELECT r.org_id_raw, a.org_id AS agg_id, SUM(a.cost) AS sum_cost
FROM raw_ledger r
LEFT JOIN aggregate_usage a ON CAST(r.org_id_raw AS INTEGER) = a.org_id
WHERE r.org_id_raw LIKE '0%'
GROUP BY 1,2
LIMIT 20;
```

maya_support: replied to customer with reproducible steps and ETA: "engineers identified a schema mismatch; short-term UI patch and backfill scheduled; expect update in ~3 hours". Customer asked for CSV check in the meantime.

alex_sre: backfill finished on sample set; verified sample orgs now show numeric totals. Ran verification query: `SELECT org_id, SUM(cost) FROM reporting_usage WHERE org_id IN (555, 421) GROUP BY org_id;` returned numbers.

jules_product: long-term action items: 1) schema migration to unify org_id type, 2) add unit/integration tests around ledger backfills, 3) alert when ingest job skips rows. I'll open product/ops tickets.

samir_backend: filed GH issue #4321: "normalize org_id type across ledger pipelines" with reproducer and suggested patch.

maya_support: will update customers and keep thread open until all affected orgs verified. Thanks folks — closing loop once we confirm full backfill. :thumbsup:
